responsibility: Supplies the Linux/ELF operating-system layer for the TILE-Gx target. It defines preprocessor, assembler, and linker specs for 32/64-bit and endianness selection, chooses the dynamic linker paths and multilib default, configures profiling and executable-stack behavior, sets the thread stack protector offset when glibc provides SSP, and defines how __builtin___clear_cache is lowered either to inline libgcc cache-coherency instructions or to the libgcc helper call.
